question: In July 2025, who inaugurated the 'Mahila Arogya Kaksha' to promote women's health at Shastri Bhawan?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Arjun Ram Meghwal**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Union Minister of State for **Law and Justice** (Independent Charge), **Arjun Ram Meghwal**, inaugurated the **'Mahila Arogya Kaksha'** (Women's Health Room) at **Shastri Bhawan**, **New Delhi**.
 
• The initiative was launched in **July 2024** (referenced as **2025** in some contexts) to prioritize and promote the health and well-being of **female employees** working in various ministries and visitors.
 
• The **'Mahila Arogya Kaksha'** is designed to provide a dedicated space for **medical consultations**, primary health check-ups, and **preventive healthcare** services specifically for women.
 
• This facility aims to address common health issues faced by women in the workplace, including **maternal health**, **menstrual hygiene**, and **stress management**, ensuring a supportive work environment.
 
• The inauguration reflects the **Government of India's** commitment to **gender-sensitive** infrastructure and the holistic empowerment of women in the workforce.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Arjun Ram Meghwal:**

 
 
• He is a prominent leader from **Rajasthan** and currently serves as the **Minister of State** (Independent Charge) for the **Ministry of Law and Justice**.
 
• He represents the **Bikaner** constituency in the **Lok Sabha**.
 
• In addition to Law, he has held portfolios in **Parliamentary Affairs** and **Culture**.
 
 
 
• **Shastri Bhawan:**
 
 
• Located in **New Delhi**, it is a major government building that houses several **Union Ministries**, including **Education**, **Law and Justice**, **Information and Broadcasting**, and **Social Justice and Empowerment**.
 
• It serves as a central hub for administrative operations of the **Government of India**.
 
 
 
• **Women's Health Schemes in India:**
 
 
• **Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY):** A maternity benefit program providing **₹5,000** to pregnant and lactating mothers for the first living child.
 
• **POSHAN Abhiyaan:** Launched in **2018** to improve nutritional outcomes for children, pregnant women, and lactating mothers.
 
• **Jan Aushadhi Suvidha:** An initiative to provide **oxobiodegradable sanitary napkins** at a subsidized rate of **₹1** per pad through **Pradhan Mantri Bhartiya Janaushadhi Kendras**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Constitutional Context:**

 
 
• **Article 42** of the **Constitution of India** directs the State to make provisions for securing **just and humane conditions of work** and for **maternity relief**.
 
• The establishment of facilities like the **Mahila Arogya Kaksha** aligns with the **Directive Principles of State Policy** (DPSP).
 
 
 
• **Significance of Workplace Wellness:**
 
 
• According to various **health surveys**, dedicated medical rooms in offices increase productivity and reduce absenteeism among **women employees** by providing immediate **first-aid** and health counseling.
 
• This initiative is a step towards achieving **Sustainable Development Goal (SDG) 3** (Good Health and Well-being) and **SDG 5** (Gender Equality).
